snippet.title: MLB 2K10 (Xbox 360) Demo Gameplay Part One: Yankees vs. Phillies
snippet.description:
http://www.thesportsgamer.com

First inning of game play in the MLB 2K10 demo featuring the New York Yankees and Philadelphia Phillies. There is no announcing crew in the demo. This demo is for Xbox 360.
